name: Highlife guitar arps
desc: Bright wavetable electric-guitar highlife arpeggios broken over a I-vi-IV-V (E C#m A B) progression, with an off(1/8) second guitar an octave up for the classic interlocking two-guitar highlife shimmer, slap delay and a slow filter sweep.

code.sparse: note('<[e4 ~ ~ b4 ~ ~ g#4 ~ ~ e5 ~ ~] [c#4 ~ ~ g#4 ~ ~ e4 ~ ~ c#5 ~ ~] [a4 ~ ~ e5 ~ ~ c#5 ~ ~ a5 ~ ~] [b4 ~ ~ f#5 ~ ~ d#5 ~ ~ b5 ~ ~]>').add(note(${root})).s('wt_eguitar').lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.6,${cut}).slow(20)).decay(.14).sustain(.1).release(.1).gain(${gain}).room(${room}).delay(${dly}).orbit(4).play()
code.full: note('<[e4 ~ b4 g#4 ~ e5 b4 ~ g#5 e5 ~ b4] [c#4 ~ g#4 e4 ~ c#5 g#4 ~ e5 c#5 ~ g#4] [a4 ~ e5 c#5 ~ a5 e5 ~ c#6 a5 ~ e5] [b4 ~ f#5 d#5 ~ b5 f#5 ~ d#6 b5 ~ f#5]>').add(note(${root})).s('wt_eguitar').lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.7,${cut}*1.4).slow(16)).decay(.12).sustain(.1).release(.08).gain(${gain}).room(${room}).delay(${dly}).off(1/8, x=>x.add(note(12)).gain(${gain}*.5)).orbit(4).play()
code.peak: note('<[e4 g#4 b4 g#4 b4 e5 b4 e5 g#5 e5 b4 g#5] [c#4 e4 g#4 e4 g#4 c#5 g#4 c#5 e5 c#5 g#4 e5] [a4 c#5 e5 c#5 e5 a5 e5 a5 c#6 a5 e5 c#6] [b4 d#5 f#5 d#5 f#5 b5 f#5 b5 d#6 b5 f#5 d#6]>').add(note(${root})).s('wt_eguitar').lpf(sine.range(${cut},${cut}*1.6).slow(12)).lpq(2).decay(.1).sustain(.08).release(.06).gain(${gain}).room(${room}).delay(${dly}).off(1/8, x=>x.add(note(12)).gain(${gain}*.5)).every(4, x=>x.fast(2)).orbit(4).play()
